product_overview: A lightweight web app for individuals to view and manage their personal finances (accounts, budgets, transactions, and statistics) built with a Vite + React stack for fast, responsive UI.
core_goals: See an immediate overview of total balance and recent activity
Add and manage financial accounts and transactions
Create and track budgets and monitor progress
Explore spending and income statistics by date range and category
Review and categorize imported or pending transactions

features.name: Dashboard Viewing
features.description: Surface the user's overall financial status including total balance and recent transactions to provide a quick snapshot.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View total balance -> View recent transactions -> Navigate to /stats
Navigate to / -> View recent transactions -> Navigate to /add-transaction

features.name: Account Management
features.description: Create, edit and inspect financial accounts so users can organize multiple sources of funds.
user_flows: Navigate to /accounts -> View list of accounts -> Create a new account by entering required account details -> See the new account listed
Navigate to /accounts -> Select an existing account to edit -> Update account details -> See the updated account reflected in the list
Navigate to /accounts -> Attempt to create a new account with missing required fields -> See validation errors and remain on the creation form

features.name: Budget Tracking
features.description: Allow users to create budgets and monitor progress against targets over a period.
user_flows: Navigate to /budgets -> Create a budget with a target amount and period -> View budget progress and remaining amount
Navigate to /budgets -> View budget progress -> Navigate to /stats to inspect related spending
Navigate to /budgets -> Attempt to create a budget with an invalid amount -> See validation error and remain on the budget form

features.name: View Statistics
features.description: Display charts and breakdowns so users can analyze spending and income across categories and date ranges.
user_flows: Navigate to /stats -> Filter by date range -> View updated charts and category breakdowns
Navigate to /stats -> Interact with a chart to drill into a category -> View detailed category statistics

features.name: Transaction Inbox
features.description: Provide an inbox for imported or pending transactions where users can review and categorize items before they appear in the main ledger.
user_flows: Navigate to /inbox -> Review incoming transactions -> Categorize a transaction -> See the transaction moved to recent transactions
Navigate to /inbox -> Review incoming transactions -> Dismiss a transaction from the inbox -> See the transaction removed from the inbox

features.name: Add Transaction
features.description: Enable users to manually add a transaction with details such as amount, date, and category.
user_flows: Navigate to /add-transaction -> Enter transaction details -> Submit the transaction -> See the transaction added to recent transactions
Navigate to /add-transaction -> Submit the transaction with missing required fields -> See validation errors and remain on the form

features.name: Recurring Transactions
features.description: Let users create and manage recurring transaction schedules for regular incomes or expenses.
user_flows: Navigate to /recurring -> Create a recurring transaction schedule with amount and frequency -> See the recurring entry listed
Navigate to /recurring -> Edit an existing recurring schedule -> See the updated schedule reflected in the list

features.name: Category Management
features.description: Create and edit spending/income categories to organize transactions and improve reporting.
user_flows: Navigate to /categories -> Create a new category by providing a name and type -> See the new category listed
Navigate to /categories -> Edit an existing category -> See the updated category reflected in lists and charts
Navigate to /categories -> Assign a category to an existing transaction -> See the transaction updated with the selected category

features.name: View Statistics
features.description: View financial charts and categories statistics
